claim: Lakehouse is presented as an architectural pattern based on open direct-access formats, advanced analytics support and competitive data-management performance.
scope_limit: The paper proposes and evaluates an architecture; it does not establish that lakehouse is one indivisible product or semantic owner.
title: Lakehouse: A New Generation of Open Platforms that Unify Data Warehousing and Advanced Analytics

claim: A platform is managed as a product around user outcomes while curating replaceable capabilities behind consistent interfaces.
scope_limit: General platform guidance does not ratify any lakehouse product or define data semantics.
title: CNCF Platforms White Paper

claim: The protocol defines serial table versions, atomic log actions, reader and writer requirements, protocol evolution and table features.
scope_limit: Delta-specific identities and feature laws cannot be silently equated with Iceberg or Hudi semantics.
title: Delta Transaction Log Protocol

claim: An open protocol separates governed dataset exchange from the computing platform used by provider and consumer.
scope_limit: The protocol does not supply enterprise purpose authority, business meaning or complete disclosure governance.
title: Delta Sharing

claim: A specialist analytics provider packages an Iceberg REST catalog as a separately described product surface with governance and maintenance capabilities.
scope_limit: Bundled features do not transfer semantic ownership from table, policy, lineage or maintenance contexts.
title: Dremio Open Catalog

claim: A specialist provider offers a distributed analytical query engine that binds open tables and catalogs independently.
scope_limit: Marketing performance claims require independent benchmarks and exact workload/edition qualification.
title: Dremio Intelligent Query Engine

claim: Clustering has separate scheduling and execution phases, rewrites physical layout and records a replace action while preserving snapshot isolation constraints.
scope_limit: The documentation establishes maintenance semantics, not a universal product boundary.
title: Apache Hudi Clustering

claim: The specification combines storage-format, reader/writer, timeline, MVCC and asynchronous table-service semantics.
scope_limit: Hudi table services are capabilities of the table system unless wrapped in an independently adopted and operated service promise.
title: Apache Hudi Technical Specification

claim: A common REST catalog API separates catalog interactions from languages and engines and supports change-based commits and credential vending.
scope_limit: The protocol does not define every enterprise governance, discovery, storage or query semantic.
title: Apache Iceberg REST Catalog Specification

claim: The specification defines table identity, immutable data and metadata files, snapshots, manifests, evolution and optimistic atomic metadata replacement.
scope_limit: An interoperability specification is not an operated product, catalog service, object store or query engine.
title: Apache Iceberg Table Specification

claim: A specialist provider sells managed ingestion independently across Hudi, Iceberg and Delta table targets.
scope_limit: Vendor claims establish market/adoption evidence, not universal semantics, performance truth or qualification.
title: OneFlow Data Ingestion

claim: A specialist provider offers table compaction, clustering and cleaning as a separately operated managed service with support posture.
scope_limit: The product currently emphasizes Hudi and cannot establish format-neutral conformance by claim alone.
title: Onehouse Table Optimizer

claim: Polaris is an independently deployable Iceberg REST catalog interoperating with multiple engines.
scope_limit: One implementation does not define the complete catalog semantic contract or qualify all provider offers.
title: Apache Polaris

claim: A query engine can independently bind an Iceberg table profile, one of several catalog types and one supported filesystem provider.
scope_limit: Connector support is edition- and feature-bounded and includes potentially lossy type mappings.
title: Trino Iceberg Connector

claim: Cross-format translation has explicit feature and representation limitations, including unsupported generated columns and log/delete-vector behavior.
scope_limit: Successful translation of a subset cannot justify lossless equivalence for every table feature.
title: Apache XTable Features and Limitations

claim: XTable translates metadata among Delta, Hudi and Iceberg without defining a new table format.
scope_limit: Translation is an interoperability capability; it neither proves semantic equivalence nor creates a table product.
title: Apache XTable Overview
